**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new shape is `retryCount`. It now takes either. See [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6). `isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. Unset now means `false`. See [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are still there. They are real deprecations in `src/legacy/`, plus a circular import between `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js`. Want me to clear those next?
